name: Elyria Admission Runtime
allowed_use_boundary: Use the public buyer-review release and repository as source evidence for Elyria request/response translation and bounded runtime semantics.
Do not infer a callable public runtime endpoint from repository, release, documentation, localhost, container, or source URLs.
Treat Elyria verdicts and receipts as foreign-framework observations; StegVerse authority remains with its own governed path.
claims: The public release describes a consequence-admission runtime with deterministic verdicting, evidence gates, signed receipts, replay verification, exposure graphing, and proof export.
The public API surface includes POST /movements/assess for movement assessment.
non_claims: The public release does not establish an independently observed callable owner-operated network endpoint.
Elyria verdicts do not grant StegVerse admission or execution authority.
Source/release verification does not prove authentic two-way StegVerse-to-Elyria transport.

transition_table_mapping.allowed_use_boundary: foreign consequence-admission observation and receipt evidence only
transition_table_mapping.claims: movement assessment, deterministic ADMIT/HOLD/REFUSE/NO_PROVABLE_ADMISSION verdicts, signed receipts, replay and no-bind/proof surfaces
transition_table_mapping.non_claims: no StegVerse standing, transition admission, execution authority, or endpoint availability inherited
transition_table_mapping.output_artifact_type: Elyria verdict plus foreign signed receipt/replay evidence
transition_table_mapping.actor_or_authority_model: Elyria evaluates its own movement conditions; authority does not transfer into StegVerse
transition_table_mapping.evidence_model: public release/repository source plus authentic runtime response evidence when independently observed
transition_table_mapping.policy_or_rule_model: Elyria authority, standing, evidence, custody and refusal conditions
transition_table_mapping.delegation_model: must be established separately in StegVerse; not inherited from Elyria
transition_table_mapping.receipt_or_trace_model: foreign signed receipt, replay checks, no-bind/proof packet surfaces
transition_table_mapping.reconstruction_model: source plus exact request/response/receipt evidence can reconstruct the bounded foreign observation
transition_table_mapping.SPE_overlap: foreign standing/evidence observations may enter StegVerse review as evidence
transition_table_mapping.StegVerse_ecosystem_overlap: external-adapter round trip across existing SDK and Interlock/InTr boundary
transition_table_mapping.fail_closed_conditions: missing exact identity, unsupported verdict, malformed receipt, unqualified endpoint, missing endpoint evidence, or authority promotion

SPE_overlap.receipt_reconstruction: foreign receipt preserved as evidence; Master Records custody remains separate

StegVerse_ecosystem_overlap.execution_path: only through evidence-qualified endpoint binding plus existing Interlock/InTr transport

fail_closed_conditions: source reference or version is missing
runtime endpoint is inferred from source or documentation
endpoint evidence is missing or malformed
foreign verdict or receipt is promoted to StegVerse authority
authentic round-trip evidence is claimed without network response and Master Records custody
